info.title: PKHeX-NX
info.author: cbreezy210
info.description: Native Switch Pokémon SV save editor
info.details:
PKHeX-NX is a native Switch homebrew app for editing Pokémon Scarlet/Violet saves directly on console.

SAFETY-FIRST ARCHITECTURE: Byte-verified SD backups before every write, dual-file commit system with rollback (ZL button), SHA256 checksum verification, and Applet Mode protection to prevent crashes.

FEATURES: Full box viewer (32x30 grid), complete stat editor (IVs/EVs/Nature/Ability), legal move picker (M11 generator), force shiny, Tera Type changer, and species editor (Gen 9 validated). No PC required.

DOCUMENTATION: Includes IS/IS NOT scope tables, ASCII install guides, Known Gaps transparency, and a public development roadmap.

TECHNICAL SPECS: Built with C++17/libnx/devkitPro. Custom SHA256 + xorpad crypto implementation. PK9 Decrypt8/Encrypt8 with LCG shuffle. Tested on FW 22.5.0 (Atmosphere 1.11.2 E).

INSTALLATION: Requires Title Override launch method (hold [R] while launching Pokémon SV). Full guide on GitHub.

COMMUNITY: Active development with 777+ GBATemp views, 2.7k+ Reddit views, volunteer
